messages:
alex: FYI onboarding partner CloudFab sent session-aggregated usage (session-level tokens) and our EU ledger shows inflated totals.
maria: can we see a sample payload? we need to know if they can send per-call detail. :thinking_face:
sam: sample they shared:
```{
  "partner_id": "cloudfab-23",
  "session_id": "s-xyz987",
  "start": "2026-03-21T09:00:00Z",
  "end": "2026-03-21T09:30:00Z",
  "tokens_used": 9000,
  "sku": "cf-pro"
}```
sam: they send a single row per session; our billing/entitlements expect per-inference call rows.
june: region is missing too. if region is absent we misattribute taxes/credits.
ops_lead: correct, most sessions look like eu-central. wrong region causes invoice differences.
alex: short-term plan: ingestion will split session tokens into synthetic calls using sku_avg_tokens and tag synthetic=true so downstream reconciliation can detect them.
maria: that needs to be auditable and reversible if partner supplies call-level rows later.
billing-bot: ingest-warning partner=cloudfab-23 field=region missing
sam: medium term: update schema to accept either request_list or call_count+region_breakdown; AE to negotiate contract change.
june: add metric: percent_tokens_synthetic by partner + alert when >5%.
alex: timeline: hotfix by EOD tomorrow. sam to PR, june to add metric, alex to schedule partner call.
maria: ops SQL snippet for audits:
```SELECT partner_id, session_id, SUM(CASE WHEN synthetic='t' THEN tokens ELSE 0 END) as synthetic_tokens, SUM(tokens) as total_tokens FROM billing_events WHERE partner_id='cloudfab-23' AND created_at >= '2026-03-21' GROUP BY partner_id, session_id;```
sam: i'll include e2e test ensuring totals reconcile when partner later provides per-call rows.
alex: add console banner "Partner usage shape heuristic applied" and docs link for transparency for 48h after fix.
maria: action items:
- sam: implement hotfix + synthetic tagging (PR + tests) due 2026-03-25
- june: dashboard metric + alert due 2026-03-26
- alex: partner call scheduled 2026-03-24 10:00 PT
- ops_lead: update reconciliation playbook for retroactive conversions due 2026-03-27

maria: keeping thread open; will post PR link when ready.
